t: A New Zealand Year 11 video game course built on Godot 4 and GDScript.
steps: Find the Godot Year 11 course site from James Hargest College.
Read the plan for all three units.
Ask IT to install Godot 4 on student laptops.
Start with the Python course in Term 1.
Follow the Learning to Make Video Games in Godot pages.
Note that HTML export in Godot 4 did not work on macOS at the time the page was written.
Plan whether to run the optional game jam.
